_notes: Echo Isles boss + named-rare loot (2026-10-21). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make).

The Razorjaw.name: Razorjaw's Serrated Edge
The Razorjaw.flavor_text: A tooth the length of a forearm in a driftwood hilt. It bites the way it was grown to.

The Razorjaw.name: Sharkskin Reaver's Vest
The Razorjaw.flavor_text: Cured while it was still angry. The grain runs towards the wearer's prey.

The Razorjaw.name: Apex-Jaw Bulwark
The Razorjaw.flavor_text: Two plates of fused jawbone. Nothing has bitten through it since.

The Razorjaw.name: Reefcaller's Tidal Choker
The Razorjaw.flavor_text: A tooth, a pearl and a promise. The reef answers to it, politely.

Warden Ssaleth.name: Ssaleth's Tidal Trident
Warden Ssaleth.flavor_text: Three barbed tines and a shaft of fossil coral. It hums at high tide.

Warden Ssaleth.name: Warden's Scalemail Hauberk
Warden Ssaleth.flavor_text: Overlapping scales that shed water the way a roof sheds rain.

Warden Ssaleth.name: Runekeeper's Drowned Cowl
Warden Ssaleth.flavor_text: The inside is lined with tiny runes. Reading them aloud is discouraged.

Warden Ssaleth.name: Coil of the Ruin-Warden
Warden Ssaleth.flavor_text: A belt of braided kelp-iron. It will outlast the temple it came from.

Captain Morrow.name: Captain Morrow's Boarding Cutlass
Captain Morrow.flavor_text: Pitted to the guard, still sharp where it counts.

Captain Morrow.name: Dead Man's Flintlock
Captain Morrow.flavor_text: It fired once more, the day they pulled it up. Nobody liked how it sounded.

Captain Morrow.name: Drowned Captain's Greatcoat
Captain Morrow.flavor_text: Heavy with brine and brass. It still stands up on its own.

Captain Morrow.name: Barnacled Signet of the Tides
Captain Morrow.flavor_text: The crest on it is a lighthouse. The nearest one is four hundred miles away.

Tidelord Gharesh.name: Tide-Heart Staff
Tidelord Gharesh.flavor_text: A column of standing water trapped in a staff. The pull of it is slightly unreasonable.

Tidelord Gharesh.name: Crown of the Drowned Tidelord
Tidelord Gharesh.flavor_text: Pearl and kelp-iron. The wearer breathes easier, and a little wetter.

Tidelord Gharesh.name: Surge-Wrought Greaves
Tidelord Gharesh.flavor_text: Plates that move with the tide. They do not move with you, unless you ask nicely.

Tidelord Gharesh.name: Foam-Spun Cloak
Tidelord Gharesh.flavor_text: Spun from sea-foam and something stubborn. It never quite dries.

Zalazane.name: Zalazane's Hexcarved Scepter
Zalazane.flavor_text: Every notch is a name. Some of the names are still listening.

Zalazane.name: Mantle of the Darkspear Claimed
Zalazane.flavor_text: Woven of the feathers of a hundred prayers. Zalazane never answered a single one.

Zalazane.name: Bonewoven Spiritwalker Harness
Zalazane.flavor_text: Ribs of a dozen beasts, tied in a knot that only a hunter can untie.

Zalazane.name: Hexbreaker's Maul
Zalazane.flavor_text: A club of petrified mangrove with a skull-shaped head. It was made to unmake hexes.

Houndmaster Gor'tek.name: Kennel-Keeper's Hooked Axe
Houndmaster Gor'tek.flavor_text: One side for splitting, the other for dragging a stubborn hound home.

Houndmaster Gor'tek.name: Houndhide Leggings
Houndmaster Gor'tek.flavor_text: Stitched from three different dogs. They would have gotten along.

Houndmaster Gor'tek.name: Pack-Bound Spaulders
Houndmaster Gor'tek.flavor_text: Chain links studded with teeth. Some of them are even the hound's.

Houndmaster Gor'tek.name: Whistle of the Kennelmaster
Houndmaster Gor'tek.flavor_text: Silent to people. The hounds hear it three islands away.

Mam'toth the Hexweaver.name: Hexweaver's Spindle
Mam'toth the Hexweaver.flavor_text: A drop-spindle wound with something that is not wool.

Mam'toth the Hexweaver.name: Threads of Mam'toth
Mam'toth the Hexweaver.flavor_text: The hem moves a little when you are not looking at it.

Mam'toth the Hexweaver.name: Weaver's Binding Cord
Mam'toth the Hexweaver.flavor_text: A hex cord, repurposed. Healers swear it is not so very different.

Mam'toth the Hexweaver.name: Hexbound Fetish Ring
Mam'toth the Hexweaver.flavor_text: The fetish has a face. The face has opinions.

Moj'bashi the Drowned.name: Drowned Warrior's Brineblade
Moj'bashi the Drowned.flavor_text: A Darkspear blade that spent forty years underwater and learned patience.

Moj'bashi the Drowned.name: Kelp-Slick Boots
Moj'bashi the Drowned.flavor_text: Slippery on the outside, steady on the inside. Which is the right way round.

Moj'bashi the Drowned.name: Tide-Bound Troll Ring
Moj'bashi the Drowned.flavor_text: A ring of braided sinew. It remembers breathing, and tries to remind you.

Seer Sshara.name: Seer's Pearl Scepter
Seer Sshara.flavor_text: A black pearl in a coral claw. The reflection in it is slightly ahead of you.

Seer Sshara.name: Sshara's Veil of Brine
Seer Sshara.flavor_text: Spider-fine silk that tastes of the sea. The wearer sees in two directions at once.

Seer Sshara.name: Seastrand Wristlets
Seer Sshara.flavor_text: Mail links the size of rice grains. The tide has polished every one.

Seer Sshara.name: Siren's Tear
Seer Sshara.flavor_text: A drop of brine that never fell. It rings faintly when something sings nearby.

Shellcrusher Kragg.name: Shellcrusher Pauldrons
Shellcrusher Kragg.flavor_text: Carapace plate the size of a dinner platter. The edges are surprisingly polite.

Shellcrusher Kragg.name: Claw-Hammer of the Flats
Shellcrusher Kragg.flavor_text: A claw, lashed to a haft. It has not forgotten its last meal.

Shellcrusher Kragg.name: Crab-Shell Buckler
Shellcrusher Kragg.flavor_text: Smaller than it looks, harder than it should be.

Shellcrusher Kragg.name: Codex of the Patient Flame
Shellcrusher Kragg.flavor_text: It only opens to pages you have already read.
Shellcrusher Kragg.label: Tome (Int/Spi)

Old Barnacle-Beard.name: Barnacle-Beard's Boarding Axe
Old Barnacle-Beard.flavor_text: The edge has more barnacles than steel. It cuts anyway, out of spite.

Old Barnacle-Beard.name: Salt-Stiffened Tricorn
Old Barnacle-Beard.flavor_text: It has seen a lot of weather. None of it was good.

Old Barnacle-Beard.name: Rum-Soaked Sash
Old Barnacle-Beard.flavor_text: You can smell the past. You can also smell the rum. They overlap.

Old Barnacle-Beard.name: Boarding Crossbow
Old Barnacle-Beard.flavor_text: A ship's crossbow, built to fire across a deck and not look back.
